blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: A tree is nodes with children below a root. In a binary search tree, smaller values go left and larger go right, so a search can skip a whole subtree at each step.

items: Linked list: cheap insert and delete

blocks.body: Sorted input makes a BST a chain. Free a tree children first. A trie trades memory for letter-by-letter speed.
